card.name: The g in hyphenated mg doses
card.fires_on: The letter g completing the unit mg in a hyphenated strength such as 70-mg or 25-mg before the word tablet or dose. Also fires once on the ending of a website name.

modes.label: Hyphenated mg strength
modes.description: The g of mg right after a number and hyphen, describing a single tablet or loading dose.
